definitions.explanation: A verbal or written response to a question, call, or message. Often used with the verb する.

examples.japanese: {返事|へんじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{返事|へんじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|き}ました→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: The reply to my email came.

examples.japanese: ⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれたら→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧{返事|へんじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please answer when your name is called.

notes:
{返事|へんじ} means reply or answer to a call or message.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {返事|へんじ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to reply (verb)
- {返事|へんじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧: a reply comes
- {返事|へんじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧: to wait for a reply
- {返事|へんじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to reply
- {返事|へんじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: no reply
- ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧{返事|へんじ}: good news/positive reply
- ⟦{生返事|なまへんじ}→生返事：17202_namahenji⟧: half-hearted reply

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {返事|へんじ}: response to call/message
- ⟦{答|こた}え→答え：00790_kotae⟧: answer to question/problem
- ⟦{回答|かいとう}→回答：00142_kaitou⟧: formal answer/response
- ⟦{応答|おうとう}→応答：12685_outou⟧: response (formal)
